query:
A factory plans purchasing and production for 100 products (P1–P100) over a single planning horizon. Each product can only be purchased/produced in whole batches, where one batch equals 10 units. So, batch_size_units is fixed batch size in units =10. Producing one unit of any product consumes three limited resources (R1, R2, R3). Each product also faces an upper demand bound; producing beyond this bound is not allowed (unmet demand is permitted). The goal is to choose batch quantities to maximize total profit (=sum over products of (10 * x_i * profit_per_unit_i)) while respecting all resource and demand limits.

    The referring data is listed in the csv file. factory_products_100.csv consists of profit earned per produced unit (positive, real). Among them r1_per_unit, r2_per_unit, r3_per_unit represent resource consumption per produced unit for R1, R2, R3 (real) respectively. upper_demand_units means maximum market demand (units) for the product (integers not equal to multiples of 10, so batch decisions meaningfully interact with demand).
    resources_capacities.csv includes total available amount of each resource in the horizon (real)

##### Decision Variables

Let $x_i$ be the number of batches of product $i$ to produce, for $i=1,\ldots,100$.

##### Parameters

- $profit\_per\_unit_i$: profit per unit of product $i$
- $r1\_per\_unit_i$: units of resource R1 consumed per unit of product $i$
- $r2\_per\_unit_i$: units of resource R2 consumed per unit of product $i$
- $r3\_per\_unit_i$: units of resource R3 consumed per unit of product $i$
- $upper\_demand\_units_i$: maximum market demand (units) for product $i$
- $batch\_size\_units = 10$
- $R1\_capacity = 27380.54$
- $R2\_capacity = 22245.11$
- $R3\_capacity = 15147.73$

##### Objective Function

$\max \sum_{i=1}^{100} \left( batch\_size\_units \cdot x_i \cdot profit\_per\_unit_i \right)$

##### Constraints

###### 1. Resource Capacity Constraints

$\sum_{i=1}^{100} \left( batch\_size\_units \cdot x_i \cdot r1\_per\_unit_i \right) \leq R1\_capacity$

$\sum_{i=1}^{100} \left( batch\_size\_units \cdot x_i \cdot r2\_per\_unit_i \right) \leq R2\_capacity$

$\sum_{i=1}^{100} \left( batch\_size\_units \cdot x_i \cdot r3\_per\_unit_i \right) \leq R3\_capacity$

###### 2. Demand Upper Bound Constraints

$batch\_size\_units \cdot x_i \leq upper\_demand\_units_i \qquad \forall i=1,\ldots,100$

###### 3. Batch Integer Constraints

$x_i \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0} \qquad \forall i=1,\ldots,100$
